name: My Son
provinceNote: The sanctuary’s own pages print Thôn Mỹ Sơn, xã Thu Bồn, Da Nang. UNESCO still prints Duy Phu Commune, Duy Xuyen District, Quang Nam.
dotReason: Worth it if you are already nearby
summary: Sleep in Hoi An and give My Son the morning. It is a closed valley of Cham brick towers, 45 km by road, not a night of its own. A foreign adult ticket is 150,000 VND and a Vietnamese adult ticket is 100,000 VND. The published close is 17:00 on one notice and 18:00 on the live ticket site, so go early. The Hoi An tourist bus is paused.
getThere: 45 km by road from Hoi An. The minutes are check on arrival.
seoTitle: My Son sanctuary — Cham towers, a morning from Hoi An
seoDescription: A morning of Cham brick towers, 45 km from Hoi An. A foreign adult pays 150,000 VND. Closing is printed as both 17:00 and 18:00, and the Hoi An bus is paused.
intro: You come for the brick. The towers sit in a closed basin, forest at the foot of the walls and a ring of hills behind, and they were the religious center of the Champa kingdom from the 4th century to the 13th. Sleep in Hoi An if the old town is the night you wanted. Come out here if the Cham towers are the morning. Sleep in Da Nang only if that city is already the hotel. The sanctuary prints 45 km from Hoi An and 68 km from Da Nang, and it does not print the minutes.

Start at the museum beside the Khe Thẻ stream, then take the electric cart. The ride is about 2 km, and the 2020 visitor guide includes it in the entrance ticket. The towers you are most likely to find standing are in groups B, C, and D. A management essay from 25 Feb 2025 says tower A1, once 24 meters, came down in a 1969 bombing, and that about 20 towers remain. UNESCO’s inscription still counts eight groups and 71 monuments. Those totals do not match. Walk what the board has open. Do not climb the brick, and do not eat inside the monument area. Stay on the paths. UNESCO still records unidentified unexploded ordnance in the buffer zone.

The daytime Cham clock is part of the visit. Hall slots run at 09:45, 10:30, 11:15, 14:00, and 16:00. Group G is at 09:00 and 14:45, and bad weather can stop that show. On the 15th of the month, Echoes of My Son is in groups B, C, and D at 09:00 and 14:45. Đêm Mỹ Sơn huyền thoại is an evening show inside the grounds. On 1 Dec 2025 the deputy in charge said the calendar is not fixed. Do not stay for a night you have not confirmed. A 2019 notice closes the whole site at 17:00. The live ticket site sells tickets until 17:30 and ends visiting at 18:00. Use the earlier time unless the gate tells you otherwise.
gettingAround: There is no walk from Hoi An and no train into the valley. Hire a car. The sanctuary’s own distances are 45 km from Hoi An and 68 km from Da Nang city, with no drive time on the page. The door from Da Nang airport is a further unsourced leg. Tourism bus 01DL, Hoi An to My Son to Cong Troi Dong Giang, is paused for six months from 15 Sep 2026. The notice names no replacement. Cars stop at the museum. The electric cart does the last 2 km. One southbound train, SE10, prints a stop at Ga Tra Kieu. The road from that station to the gate is check on arrival. The sanctuary’s 20 km is to the old citadel of Tra Kieu, not a timed ride from the platform.

stayAreas.name: Hoi An
stayAreas.summary: Sleep in the old town. My Son is the morning out, 45 km by road, and the valley is not where the evening is.

stayAreas.name: Da Nang
stayAreas.summary: Sleep here if the airport or the beach is already your night. The sanctuary prints 68 km from the city. The minutes are check on arrival.

eat: Eat in Hoi An before you leave, or back in Hoi An or Da Nang after the gate. The ticket rules forbid eating in the monument area. The sanctuary’s services list has crafts and shows, not a food street.
interestsBody: The brick in the valley is the reason to come. Groups B, C, and D are where a 2025 management essay says most of the remaining towers stand. The museum at the gate is the start, beside the Khe Thẻ stream, before the cart.

Daytime Cham performances run in the hall, at group G, and, on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, at the group H slope. Echoes of My Son is the 15th, in groups B, C, and D. The evening show has no fixed date.
The night is not here. Sleep in Hoi An, 45 km back. There is no food street on the sanctuary’s own pages, and the ticket rules forbid eating in the monument area.

interestCards.title: The brick in the valley
interestCards.summary: Standing Cham towers, mostly the groups that remain in B, C, and D.

interestCards.title: The museum at the gate
interestCards.summary: A gallery beside the Khe Thẻ stream, before the cart. The towers are still the valley.

interestCards.title: Performances in the valley
interestCards.summary: Hall slots, group G, and singing at the group H slope. The night show has no fixed date.

interestCards.title: The night in Hoi An
interestCards.summary: The valley closes in the afternoon. Sleep 45 km back in the old town.

season.label: Rains from October
season.note: Da Nang’s climate page, dated 4 May 2026, calls January to September dry and October to December rainy, with floods usual in September to November and storms mainly September to December. UNESCO also names flooding and high humidity at the sanctuary. This is not a closure notice. If the road is shut, check that morning.

faqs.q: Should you stay the night at My Son?
faqs.a: No. Sleep in Hoi An, or in Da Nang if that is already the hotel. The sanctuary prints 45 km from Hoi An and does not print a drive time. The published close is 17:00 on a 2019 notice and 18:00 on the live ticket site.

faqs.q: Is the bus from Hoi An running?
faqs.a: Tourism bus 01DL is paused for six months from 15 Sep 2026. The notice names no replacement. Come by road, and check the minutes that morning.
A foreign adult pays 150,000 VND and a Vietnamese adult pays 100,000 VND on the live ticket site and on the 2026 city list. The child fare is not the same sentence on every page. Check it on arrival.
